_schema._about: Copy for every home section after the hero, in page order: features → quotes → stories → rights. Hero copy lives in hero.json; nav/footer in nav.json/footer.json. Access with dot paths and numeric indices, e.g. {{content:home.features.items.0.title}}.
_schema.meta: {title ≤60 chars, description ≤155 chars, ogTitle, ogDescription}. Head tags for /.
_schema.features: the reference site 'Run smarter, serve better.' {heading (4 words, 42px display), sub (16px grey, the reference site 17 words), items[4]: {title (500 weight, inline before desc), desc (the reference site 9–10 words), href (optional: the service page this card mirrors), mockAlt (alt text for the card's mock image; the features agent draws the mock — no real screenshots)}}.
_schema.quotes: the reference site's two big 36px quotes over full-bleed imagery. items[2]: {reserved: bool, text, name, role, tag (only on the reserved slot: a small jam-dotted tag), imageAlt}. Item 0 is the founder's real statement (CONTRACT §10); item 1 is the reserved slot with no invented name.
_schema.stories: the reference site 'Trusted by leading hotels / running every shift on the reference site' carousel. {eyebrow (replaces the reference site's '50+ hotels' stat with an offer fact, §10), heading: {line1 (white), line2 (rendered at 40% opacity)}, prev/next aria labels, cards[4]: {slot, reserved: true, quote, attribution, meta, read (inert), href (null = inert), format (hint for the phone silhouette's alt text only — not rendered), imageAlt}}. Cards keep the reference site's anatomy but are designed reserved slots: dashed hairline frame, line-drawn phone silhouette.
_schema.rights: the reference site 'Privacy and Security at Every Layer' on sand. {heading (6 words), sub (the reference site 11 words), learnMore: {label, href}, items[4]: {id, title (rendered uppercase eyebrow), desc (the reference site 14–21 words), sealAlt (our own line-drawn seal; only UK GDPR is backed by the privacy policy — none is a certification)}}.

meta.title: UGC agency in London: directed creator ads | hypjam
meta.description: hypjam is a London UGC agency: we brief, cast and direct creators, cut for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, and put usage rights in writing. From £1,800 a month.
meta.ogTitle: UGC agency in London: directed creator ads | hypjam
meta.ogDescription: hypjam is a London UGC agency: we brief, cast and direct creators, cut for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, and put usage rights in writing. From £1,800 a month.

features.heading: Find the format. Then film it.
features.sub: We study the formats already earning attention in your category, write original scripts around them, and make more of whatever performs. One team briefs, casts, directs and edits every video.

items.title: Hook writing
items.desc: Eight hooks per script, written before anyone presses record.
items.mockAlt: Mock of a hook sheet: eight numbered hook lines, two ticked in orange

items.title: Casting
items.desc: Creators cast for fit, not follower count, from our roster.
items.mockAlt: Mock of a casting board: line-drawn creator cards with niche and age tags, three shortlisted

items.title: Shoot direction
items.desc: Shot lists, retakes and live notes, so nothing is guesswork.
items.mockAlt: Mock of a shoot sheet: a phone frame with a record dot and a take list being ticked off

items.title: Editing & rights
items.desc: Platform-native cuts, captions, and usage rights for organic and paid.
items.mockAlt: Mock of an edit timeline with a captions toggle and usage-rights terms attached to the export

items.text: We started hypjam because brands kept hiring creators one by one and nobody was directing the work. We treat UGC like a production: one brief, one team, a script before anyone films, an edit built for the feed.
items.name: Avi Aggarwal
items.imageAlt: Blurred phone shoot: a ring light and a phone on a tripod over a kitchen counter

items.text: We would rather show you nothing than words a brand never said.
items.name: hypjam
items.imageAlt: Blurred shot of an empty sofa set, lit and waiting

cards.imageAlt: A vertical hook-led UGC ad made by hypjam, shown in a phone-shaped frame

cards.quote: A screen-recorded demo, captioned to work with the sound off.
cards.imageAlt: A vertical screen-recorded product demo made by hypjam, captioned 'Building an ad creative'

rights.heading: Rights and safety at every layer
rights.sub: Protect your brand, your creators and your ad account before anyone presses record.

items.title: Usage rights in writing
items.desc: Organic and paid usage for the term of your package, written into the contract, not implied in a DM.
items.sealAlt: Line-drawn seal: a signed page with a play triangle

items.title: Signed creator releases
items.desc: Every creator signs a release before filming, covering the footage, usage window and whitelisting, so the rights are clean.
items.sealAlt: Line-drawn seal: a pen signing a release form

items.title: ASA and CAP disclosure compliance
items.desc: Paid partnerships are labelled and every ad follows the CAP Code the ASA enforces. Our practice, not a certification.
items.sealAlt: Line-drawn seal: an ad label tag reading AD

items.title: UK GDPR data handling
items.desc: Creator and client data handled under UK GDPR, as our privacy policy sets out. No cookies, no trackers.
items.sealAlt: Line-drawn seal: a padlock inside a ring of twelve dots
